entry_item.definition: T. thig le; S. bindu. A drop, zero or cypher; a circular mark over a letter in S. , T. , and sometimes M. indicating nazalization of the inherent vowel; in mystic language: sperm, the essence of sperm ( M. dusul) = bodicid.
n. A diacritical sign. An "o" or a mark appended to a letter or word to show the pronunciation of the word. These circles are also used to mark striking passages.
To apply a circle or an "o" at the side of a letter or word.
